messages.text: How do changes in AI data centers technology affect the measurement capability required from Signaling / Non-signaling Tester?

### Short answer
The passages support that AI data-center technology changes increase emphasis on high-speed interconnect, optical/fiber, PCB material/SI, power, and cooling measurements, but they do not directly state that those changes require a specific Signaling / Non-signaling Tester capability; the directly supported Signaling / Non-signaling Tester evidence is for wireless device RF testing such as CMX500 signaling and CMP180 production non-signaling RF testing [61][3][62][63][84][25][32].
### Supported technical changes
- AI/data-center connectivity is described as a full-spectrum portfolio covering high-speed electrical interconnect, optical interconnect, fiber deployment, rack power distribution, busbar, liquid cooling, and leak detection [61].  
- High-speed electrical connectivity in the passages includes OSFP cable assemblies from 25G/lane NRZ up to 224G/lane PAM4 with 200G, 400G, 800G, and 1.6T aggregate bandwidths, XtremePass 448G connector solutions, and 224 Gb/s PAM4 BGA mezzanine connectors [3].  
- Optical connectivity in the passages includes 224 Gb/s per lane across 64 channels for XPO-LPO, 200G/lane 1.6T OSFP optical modules for 800G / 1.6T Ethernet applications, CPO architecture from electrical interposer to optical conversion to fiber plant, and 300G cumulative optical transceiver examples [62].  
- AI server PCB upgrade sources say AI servers push PCB toward higher layer count, larger area, and high-speed transmission; they also cite M8 CCL, low dielectric, low loss, high thermal design, 30–40 layer mainboards, 12–14× aspect ratio, thick copper, and laser drilling challenges [84].  
- PCB/SI measurement flows in the passages include impedance/TDR, Dk/Df extraction, insertion loss, roughness, crosstalk, transmission-line modeling, eye diagram, sampling testing, process monitoring, Delta-L, and cable/connector testing [11][12][71].  
### Effect on Signaling / Non-signaling Tester capability
- For wireless signaling testers, the directly supported capability direction is multi-technology and multi-channel RF signaling: CMX500 is described as a universal one-box network emulation and measurement solution for LTE, NR FR1, NR FR2, NSA, SA, FDD, TDD, and WLAN-related signaling/TX measurements [25].  
- For Wi-Fi 7 signaling R&D, the passages state that testing needs signaling mode under real-world conditions to measure RF TX/RX characteristics, and that MLO makes a multiple-RF-chain test environment important; listed Wi-Fi 7-specific tests include 2x2 MIMO, 6 GHz band with out-of-band discovery, coexistence, and E2E capabilities [31].  
- For Wi-Fi 8 signaling, the passages state that first Wi-Fi 8 RF tests in signaling mode were implemented on the CMX500 one-box signaling tester before final IEEE ratification, and that CMX500 is positioned as a multi-technology, multi-channel signaling tester for cellular and non-cellular standards [34].  
- For production non-signaling RF testing, the passages directly state that Wi-Fi 7 R&D/interworking is covered by CMX500 and production non-signaling RF testing is covered by CMP180, but they do not provide CMP180 measurement specifications in the cited passage [32].  
- For CMX500 non-signaling use, the passages list GPRF Generator capability to generate ARB, CW, dual tone, or replay `.wv` waveforms, and IQ recorder capability to record up to 4 Gbyte to a file and save `.wv` files for replay [40][41][42].  
### Boundary of what is not directly supported
- The passages do not provide a direct source saying that AI data-center high-speed electrical links, optical modules, CPO, PCB stackups, power distribution, or liquid cooling are tested by CMX500 or CMP180; the AI/data-center passages describe those technologies, while the CMX500/CMP180 passages describe wireless device RF signaling/non-signaling use cases [61][3][62][63][84][25][32].  
- The data-center connectivity source also lacks formal dates, datasheet versions, order numbers, compliance certificates, and test conditions for figures such as 224G, 448G, and 1.6T, so those figures are brochure claims rather than validated tester requirements [2][53].  
- The PCB test solution passages list measurement items and flows but do not provide formal R&S product model, option code, frequency range, standard, fixture, or calibration method [73][74].  
### Inference
【推論】As AI data-center interconnects move toward 224G/lane PAM4, 448G connector solutions, 800G/1.6T cable or optical applications, and more complex PCB materials/processes, the measurement burden shifts more toward high-speed SI/PI and PCB measurements such as insertion loss, TDR impedance, Dk/Df, roughness, crosstalk, eye diagram, Delta-L, and cable/connector testing, rather than only traditional RF signaling tests [3][62][84][11][12][71].  
【推論】For Signaling / Non-signaling Tester planning, CMX500/CMP180 evidence supports requirements around wireless RF signaling, multi-technology/multi-channel testing, Wi-Fi 7/8, MLO, MIMO, coexistence, E2E, and non-signaling waveform generation or production RF testing, but the passages do not verify them as the measurement platform for AI data-center electrical/optical interconnect validation [31][34][32][40][41][42].

- [[full-spectrum-data-center-connectivity-brochure]] 未標示正式日期；所有產品能力、規格數字與 marketing claim 需標示來源日期缺口。

R&S CMX500 › 產品定位
依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援最新 3GPP [[5G NR]] technology，適用於 device testing，涵蓋 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]，並支援 non-standalone（NSA）、standalone（SA）、FDD 與 TDD。

依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 也提供：

- [[NR FR1]] / [[NR FR2]] signaling 與 TX measurements。
- [[LTE]] signaling、LTE-DTC / direct-to-cell communication、LTE measurements。
- [[NB-IoT]] / NB-NTN signaling。
- [[WLAN]] signaling 與 WLAN TX measurements，涵蓋 802.11a/b/g/n/ac、802.11ax、802.11be、802.11bn 與 2x2 MIMO。
- [[Fading]]、[[AWGN]]、[[BLER]]、[[CSI report]]、[[Throughput measurement]]、[[PER measurement]]。
- Application test、IP traffic analysis、IMS / audio / [[POLQA]]。
- GUI、graphical scripting、Python-based [[XLAPI]] 與 [[SCPI]] remote control。

R&S CMX500 › Application tests 與 audio
依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]：

- 未啟用 R&S CMX-KA100 等 application test license 時，IP application test functionality 降到最低；只能使用 standalone mode，不能連接 external servers，也不支援 IP based measurements 或 tools。
- R&S CMX-KA100 提供 internal IP services 與 IP connection to DUT 測試 applications，包含 DNS、IMS、Message Center、FTP、HTTP、DNS monitor、IP logging、iPerf、Ping、throughput、Max Throughput Wizard、web server。
- R&S CMX-KA110 增強 KA100，加入 QoS、ePDG、N3IWF、delay measurement、IP tune tool、SMPP / MT SMS advanced settings。
- R&S CMX-KA150 提供 IP analysis tool，用於監控與分析 DUT uplink / downlink IP traffic。
- R&S CMX-KA180 提供 audio codecs for 4G and 5G IMS voice call，支援 AMR-NB、AMR-WB、EVS，並包含 [[R&S CMX-ZG180A]] external sound card drivers and configuration settings。
- R&S CMX-KA181 加入 [[POLQA]]，用於 measuring perceived speech quality；measurement version 為 3，mode 為 full-band 或 narrowband。
- R&S CMX-KA401 支援 WAV player / recorder、upload/download WAV files、file-based POLQA measurements 與 end-to-end audio delay。

R&S CMX500 › mmWave extension 與 remote radio heads
[[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]] 指出 3GPP FR2 frequency range 測試可由 [[R&S CMX500]] 搭配 [[R&S CMXHEAD30]]、[[R&S CMXHEAD50]] 或 [[R&S CMXHEAD50-Evo]] 執行。Remote radio head 是獨立 compact unit，在 IF 與 5G NR FR2 frequency ranges 間執行 upconversion / downconversion。CMX500 與 remote radio head 的 split concept 可在 5G NR FR2 frequency range 使用短 RF cable lengths，以最佳化 radiated chamber test environments 的 link budget。

適用 radiated chamber test environments：[[R&S CMQ500]] shielding cube 與 [[R&S ATS800R]] CATR rack based antenna test system。

CMX500 Callbox › Callbox 定位
依 [[CMX500_Callbox]]，callbox 的核心敘事是：

- Easy to set up。
- Easy to get in a call。
- Easy to test with。
- Focus on [[RF Testing]]，including [[3GPP pre-conformance]]。

來源以 [[Device Under Test]]、cell tower 與 smartphone 圖示描述 [[R&S CMX500]] 作為 DUT 連線與測試環境的中心。

CMX500 Callbox › Testing phases
[[CMX500_Callbox]] 將測試階段放在下列脈絡中：

- [[Go-NoGo Testing]]。
- [[Non-Sig Testing]]。
- [[Conformance Testing]]。
- [[R&D Testing]]。

來源未明確說這四者是完整 lifecycle，也未定義各階段 pass/fail 標準。

CMX500 Callbox
[[CMX500 Callbox]] 是 [[CMX500_Callbox]] 簡報中對 [[R&S CMX500]] 的 use-case 定位：用一台 callbox 快速建立 DUT 連線，進行 RF、mobility、application、NTN、WLAN / cellular desense、pre-conformance 與 non-signaling R&D 驗證。

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing › R&D：R&S CMX500 single-box signaling testing
依 [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]]：

- [[R&S CMX500]] 是 multi-technology multi-channel signaling tester。
- 來源稱其已新增 integrated [[Wi-Fi 7]] test functionality。
- 目的在 single instrument setup 中測試 wireless device 在 cellular 與 non-cellular latest-generation standards 下的 operation。
- Wi-Fi 7 R&D 測試需在 signaling mode 與 real-world conditions 下量測 RF TX / RX characteristics。
- [[MLO]] 是 [[Wi-Fi 7]] key feature，因此提供 multiple RF chains 的 test environment 很重要。
- 來源列出的 Wi‑Fi 7-specific tests 包含 2x2 [[MIMO]]、6 GHz band with out-of-band discovery、coexistence 與 E2E test capabilities。

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing
[[Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing]] 是 [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]] 中描述的測試方案組合：以 [[R&S CMX500]] 覆蓋 R&D signaling / interworking 測試，以 [[R&S CMP180]] 覆蓋 production non-signaling RF 測試。

- 來源將 [[R&S CMX500]] 定位為 multi-technology multi-channel signaling tester，以及 future-ready platform for cellular and non-cellular standards。

- [[Wi-Fi 8 RF signaling tests]] 目前由 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] / [[Broadcom]] PR 支撐，聚焦 [[R&S CMX500]] signaling mode、[[Wi-Fi 8]] PHY features 與 prototype Broadcom WLAN device。

Wi-Fi 7 and 5G RedCap OTA measurements › 來源中的測試架構
依 [[EMITE and Rohde & Schwarz join forces to support OTA measurements on Wi-Fi 7 and 5G RedCap]]：

- [[EMITE]] over-the-air chambers 可與 [[R&S CMX500]] one-box signaling tester 的 latest sophisticated testing features combined。
- [[R&S CMX500]] 被描述為 multi-technology、multi-channel one-box signaling tester。
- cellular technologies：[[LTE]]、[[5G NR]] [[NR FR1]] frequency range up to 8 GHz、[[NR FR2]] millimeter wave frequency range up to 50 GHz、latest [[5G RedCap]]。
- non-cellular technologies：latest [[Wi-Fi 7]]。
- integration enables support of LTE、FR1、FR2、full compliance with [[IEEE 802.11be]] and [[5G RedCap]]。
- EMITE customers obtain a comprehensive environment for accurately assessing performance of [[Wi-Fi 7]] and [[5G RedCap]] devices。

Wi-Fi 7 and 5G RedCap OTA measurements
[[Wi-Fi 7 and 5G RedCap OTA measurements]] 是 [[EMITE and Rohde & Schwarz join forces to support OTA measurements on Wi-Fi 7 and 5G RedCap]] 中描述的 OTA 測試解決方案情境：將 [[R&S CMX500]] 的 latest test capabilities 整合到 [[EMITE]] over-the-air chambers，以評估 [[Wi-Fi 7]] / [[IEEE 802.11be]] 與 [[5G RedCap]] devices 的 performance。

CMX500 GPRF Generator
[[CMX500 GPRF Generator]] 是 [[CMX500_Callbox]] 中的 [[R&S CMX500]] non-signaling use case：在 CMX500 上產生 ARB、CW、dual tone 或 replay `.wv` waveform，支援 R&D waveform replay / creation 與 standalone TX measurement 工作流。

CMX500 GPRF Generator › IQ recorder
來源稱 IQ recorder 可：

- Record up to 4 Gbyte to a file。
- Save files as `.wv` for replay。
- Use the same IQ stream + RF parameters as signaling。
- As many instances as supported by CMX hardware。
- 2 per RFU。
- 1 per IFU。
- FR1 specialist：8 instances in parallel。
- Inspect the recorded trace directly in GUI。

- Dual Tone。

answer.text:
### Short answer
The passages support that AI data-center technology changes increase emphasis on high-speed interconnect, optical/fiber, PCB material/SI, power, and cooling measurements, but they do not directly state that those changes require a specific Signaling / Non-signaling Tester capability; the directly supported Signaling / Non-signaling Tester evidence is for wireless device RF testing such as CMX500 signaling and CMP180 production non-signaling RF testing [61][3][62][63][84][25][32].
### Supported technical changes
- AI/data-center connectivity is described as a full-spectrum portfolio covering high-speed electrical interconnect, optical interconnect, fiber deployment, rack power distribution, busbar, liquid cooling, and leak detection [61].  
- High-speed electrical connectivity in the passages includes OSFP cable assemblies from 25G/lane NRZ up to 224G/lane PAM4 with 200G, 400G, 800G, and 1.6T aggregate bandwidths, XtremePass 448G connector solutions, and 224 Gb/s PAM4 BGA mezzanine connectors [3].  
- Optical connectivity in the passages includes 224 Gb/s per lane across 64 channels for XPO-LPO, 200G/lane 1.6T OSFP optical modules for 800G / 1.6T Ethernet applications, CPO architecture from electrical interposer to optical conversion to fiber plant, and 300G cumulative optical transceiver examples [62].  
- AI server PCB upgrade sources say AI servers push PCB toward higher layer count, larger area, and high-speed transmission; they also cite M8 CCL, low dielectric, low loss, high thermal design, 30–40 layer mainboards, 12–14× aspect ratio, thick copper, and laser drilling challenges [84].  
- PCB/SI measurement flows in the passages include impedance/TDR, Dk/Df extraction, insertion loss, roughness, crosstalk, transmission-line modeling, eye diagram, sampling testing, process monitoring, Delta-L, and cable/connector testing [11][12][71].  
### Effect on Signaling / Non-signaling Tester capability
- For wireless signaling testers, the directly supported capability direction is multi-technology and multi-channel RF signaling: CMX500 is described as a universal one-box network emulation and measurement solution for LTE, NR FR1, NR FR2, NSA, SA, FDD, TDD, and WLAN-related signaling/TX measurements [25].  
- For Wi-Fi 7 signaling R&D, the passages state that testing needs signaling mode under real-world conditions to measure RF TX/RX characteristics, and that MLO makes a multiple-RF-chain test environment important; listed Wi-Fi 7-specific tests include 2x2 MIMO, 6 GHz band with out-of-band discovery, coexistence, and E2E capabilities [31].  
- For Wi-Fi 8 signaling, the passages state that first Wi-Fi 8 RF tests in signaling mode were implemented on the CMX500 one-box signaling tester before final IEEE ratification, and that CMX500 is positioned as a multi-technology, multi-channel signaling tester for cellular and non-cellular standards [34].  
- For production non-signaling RF testing, the passages directly state that Wi-Fi 7 R&D/interworking is covered by CMX500 and production non-signaling RF testing is covered by CMP180, but they do not provide CMP180 measurement specifications in the cited passage [32].  
- For CMX500 non-signaling use, the passages list GPRF Generator capability to generate ARB, CW, dual tone, or replay `.wv` waveforms, and IQ recorder capability to record up to 4 Gbyte to a file and save `.wv` files for replay [40][41][42].  
### Boundary of what is not directly supported
- The passages do not provide a direct source saying that AI data-center high-speed electrical links, optical modules, CPO, PCB stackups, power distribution, or liquid cooling are tested by CMX500 or CMP180; the AI/data-center passages describe those technologies, while the CMX500/CMP180 passages describe wireless device RF signaling/non-signaling use cases [61][3][62][63][84][25][32].  
- The data-center connectivity source also lacks formal dates, datasheet versions, order numbers, compliance certificates, and test conditions for figures such as 224G, 448G, and 1.6T, so those figures are brochure claims rather than validated tester requirements [2][53].  
- The PCB test solution passages list measurement items and flows but do not provide formal R&S product model, option code, frequency range, standard, fixture, or calibration method [73][74].  
### Inference
【推論】As AI data-center interconnects move toward 224G/lane PAM4, 448G connector solutions, 800G/1.6T cable or optical applications, and more complex PCB materials/processes, the measurement burden shifts more toward high-speed SI/PI and PCB measurements such as insertion loss, TDR impedance, Dk/Df, roughness, crosstalk, eye diagram, Delta-L, and cable/connector testing, rather than only traditional RF signaling tests [3][62][84][11][12][71].  
【推論】For Signaling / Non-signaling Tester planning, CMX500/CMP180 evidence supports requirements around wireless RF signaling, multi-technology/multi-channel testing, Wi-Fi 7/8, MLO, MIMO, coexistence, E2E, and non-signaling waveform generation or production RF testing, but the passages do not verify them as the measurement platform for AI data-center electrical/optical interconnect validation [31][34][32][40][41][42].

R&S CMX500 › 產品定位
依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援最新 3GPP [[5G NR]] technology，適用於 device testing，涵蓋 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]，並支援 non-standalone（NSA）、standalone（SA）、FDD 與 TDD。

依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 也提供：

- [[NR FR1]] / [[NR FR2]] signaling 與 TX measurements。
- [[LTE]] signaling、LTE-DTC / direct-to-cell communication、LTE measurements。
- [[NB-IoT]] / NB-NTN signaling。
- [[WLAN]] signaling 與 WLAN TX measurements，涵蓋 802.11a/b/g/n/ac、802.11ax、802.11be、802.11bn 與 2x2 MIMO。
- [[Fading]]、[[AWGN]]、[[BLER]]、[[CSI report]]、[[Throughput measurement]]、[[PER measurement]]。
- Application test、IP traffic analysis、IMS / audio / [[POLQA]]。
- GUI、graphical scripting、Python-based [[XLAPI]] 與 [[SCPI]] remote control。

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing › R&D：R&S CMX500 single-box signaling testing
依 [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]]：

- [[R&S CMX500]] 是 multi-technology multi-channel signaling tester。
- 來源稱其已新增 integrated [[Wi-Fi 7]] test functionality。
- 目的在 single instrument setup 中測試 wireless device 在 cellular 與 non-cellular latest-generation standards 下的 operation。
- Wi-Fi 7 R&D 測試需在 signaling mode 與 real-world conditions 下量測 RF TX / RX characteristics。
- [[MLO]] 是 [[Wi-Fi 7]] key feature，因此提供 multiple RF chains 的 test environment 很重要。
- 來源列出的 Wi‑Fi 7-specific tests 包含 2x2 [[MIMO]]、6 GHz band with out-of-band discovery、coexistence 與 E2E test capabilities。

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing
[[Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing]] 是 [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]] 中描述的測試方案組合：以 [[R&S CMX500]] 覆蓋 R&D signaling / interworking 測試，以 [[R&S CMP180]] 覆蓋 production non-signaling RF 測試。

Wi-Fi 8 RF signaling tests › 來源中的測試情境
依 [[Rohde & Schwarz and Broadcom showcase first Wi-Fi 8 RF signaling tests, paving way for next-gen connectivity]]：

- [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 在 final IEEE standard ratification 前，已將 first [[Wi-Fi 8]] RF tests in signaling mode 實作到 [[R&S CMX500]] one-box signaling tester。
- 測試展示使用 [[Broadcom]] prototype next-generation WLAN device。
- 展示地點為 [[MWC Barcelona 2026]]，[[Rohde & Schwarz]] booth 5A80。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMX500]] 可 showcase physical layer features unique to [[Wi-Fi 8]]。
- 來源將 [[R&S CMX500]] 定位為 multi-technology multi-channel signaling tester，以及 future-ready platform for cellular and non-cellular standards。

CMX500 GPRF Generator
[[CMX500 GPRF Generator]] 是 [[CMX500_Callbox]] 中的 [[R&S CMX500]] non-signaling use case：在 CMX500 上產生 ARB、CW、dual tone 或 replay `.wv` waveform，支援 R&D waveform replay / creation 與 standalone TX measurement 工作流。

CMX500 GPRF Generator › IQ recorder
來源稱 IQ recorder 可：

- Record up to 4 Gbyte to a file。
- Save files as `.wv` for replay。
- Use the same IQ stream + RF parameters as signaling。
- As many instances as supported by CMX hardware。
- 2 per RFU。
- 1 per IFU。
- FR1 specialist：8 instances in parallel。
- Inspect the recorded trace directly in GUI。

CMX500 GPRF Generator › Signal types
依 [[CMX500_Callbox]]，GPRF Generator signal types 包含：

- ARB。
- CW。
- Dual Tone。
- Replay `.wv` files。
- Up to 4 GPRF Generator instances in parallel。
- ARB Sequencer。
- Upload directly in the configuration sidebar。

來源 slide 標示 **No License required**，但該說法需與 technology-specific ARB / WinIQSim2 licensing 分開理解。
